description: This file contains tests for the Telegram update offset store module, verifying correct behavior of reading, writing, and deleting update offset files associated with Telegram bot accounts, including handling of legacy data, invalid data, and security aspects like bot token verification.

methods.name: deleteTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Deletes the stored Telegram update offset for a specific account ID, with verification of bot token and handling legacy data.

methods.name: readTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Reads the Telegram update offset for a specific account ID, verifying bot token and handling legacy data.

methods.name: writeTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Stores the Telegram update offset for a specific account ID, ensuring the update ID is a valid non-negative integer.
